speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a pregnant patient presenting with vaginal bleeding and abdominal pain; to ensure your safety, could you please tell me exactly how many weeks pregnant you are? Also, when did the bleeding start, and is there any pain in your shoulder or rectum?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old woman, gravida 2, para 1, at 38 weeks' gestation. The patient reports experiencing vaginal bleeding for the past hour accompanied by severe abdominal pain. She mentions that she felt contractions before the onset of the bleeding, but the contractions ceased once the bleeding began. Her first childbirth was a cesarean section due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Placenta Accreta Spectrum (suggested based on prior C-section and vaginal bleeding at 38 weeks; immediate ultrasound/MRI evaluation required).

REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic Ultrasound.

REQUEST TEST: Fetal Heart Rate Monitoring.
